fields.name: 📡 BLE Beacon Ingress & Dwell Audit Trail

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$type" AS event_type, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.beacon_id') AS beacon_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.scanner_node_id') AS scanner, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.zone_id') AS zone, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.rssi_dbm') AS REAL) AS rssi, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.estimated_distance_m') AS REAL) AS distance_m, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.dwell_duration_seconds') AS REAL) AS dwell_s, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.status') AS status FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" IN ('BLEBeaconSeen', 'BLEBeaconLost') ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 30

view.title: Real-Time BLE Beacon Transition Log (Arrivals & Departures)

fields.name: 🗺️ Operation Room BLE Beacon Spatial Occupancy Map

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.beacon_id') AS entity_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.status') AS status, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.zone_id') AS zone, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.coordinates_x') AS REAL) AS pos_x, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.coordinates_y') AS REAL) AS pos_y, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.where_locagram') AS geom FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" IN ('BLEBeaconSeen', 'BLEBeaconLost') ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20

view.title: Operation Room Real-Time 2D BLE Spatial Tracker
